column1: # Stage B of the refactor program (#2062): where each item of src/widgets/editor.rs goes.
# One row per item, in file order. pr 0 means the item stays in editor.rs; the others
# move to src/widgets/editor/<file>.rs in that PR. kind, impl and name are as
# `scripts/move_items.py --target editor --check` after adding an item to editor.rs.
# A struct whose private fields other files read (and the tests do) stays in editor.rs,
# where every file under editor/ and the tests can still read them; its methods move.
